courses.name: Cloud Computing with AWS & Azure
courses.seoTitle: Cloud Computing Course with AWS & Azure — Fees, Syllabus & Placement
courses.metaDescription: Job-ready cloud computing course covering AWS and Azure fundamentals, Linux, networking and cost management. 10 weeks, live online, with placement support. See fees and syllabus.
courses.tagline: Deploy, secure and manage real workloads on the two clouds that hire the most.
courses.intro: Cloud is no longer a specialist niche — it is the default way companies run software. This course takes you from "what is a virtual machine" to confidently deploying a fault-tolerant application on both AWS and Azure, with the cost discipline that employers actually test for in interviews.

paths.job: Cloud Associate, Cloud Support Engineer, Junior DevOps Engineer
paths.freelance: Cloud migration audits and cost-optimisation reviews for small businesses
paths.business: Managed hosting and cloud-backup services for local companies

modules.title: Cloud foundations & the shared responsibility model
modules.detail: Regions, availability zones, IaaS vs PaaS vs SaaS, and how cloud billing genuinely works before you spend a rupee.

modules.title: Linux and networking essentials
modules.detail: The command line, SSH, DNS, subnets, firewalls and load balancers — the base layer every cloud interview probes.

modules.title: AWS core services
modules.detail: EC2, S3, VPC, IAM and RDS. You build a public web tier and a private database tier that talk to each other securely.

modules.title: Azure core services
modules.detail: Virtual Machines, Blob Storage, Virtual Networks and Entra ID, mapped side by side against their AWS equivalents.

modules.title: Identity, security & compliance
modules.detail: Least-privilege IAM policies, key management, encryption at rest and in transit, and reading a security audit report.

modules.title: Automation with Infrastructure as Code
modules.detail: Terraform basics — describe your infrastructure in code, version it, and rebuild an entire environment from scratch.

modules.title: Monitoring & cost optimisation
modules.detail: CloudWatch and Azure Monitor, budget alerts, right-sizing, and the reserved-instance maths that saves clients real money.

modules.title: Capstone: migrate a live application
modules.detail: Take a running on-premise app and move it to the cloud with zero data loss. This becomes the centrepiece of your portfolio.

outcomes: Deploy a highly available three-tier application on AWS
Write Terraform that provisions an entire environment reproducibly
Read and reduce a real cloud bill by at least 30%
Sit the AWS Cloud Practitioner and AZ-900 exams with confidence
Ship a documented migration case study to your Skill Passport

faqs.q: Do I need a programming background for this cloud computing course?
faqs.a: No. We start from Linux basics and networking. If you can use a computer confidently and are willing to practise on the command line, you can follow the whole course. Some scripting is introduced gradually in the Terraform module.

faqs.q: What are the cloud computing course fees at Jobjila?
faqs.a: The course is ₹18,500 including all live sessions, recordings, lab credits and one certification-exam guidance session. EMI options are available and there is a discount for students who enrol as a group.

faqs.q: Will I get placement support after this course?
faqs.a: Yes. Every learner who completes the capstone gets resume and LinkedIn review, two mock technical interviews, and their verified profile is shared with hiring partners looking for cloud associates. We do not guarantee a job — we guarantee the preparation and the introductions.

faqs.q: Are the AWS and Azure certification exam fees included?
faqs.a: No. The exam fees are paid directly to Amazon or Microsoft. We cover the syllabus, run practice tests and guide you through booking, but the certification fee itself is separate.

faqs.q: Is this course live or pre-recorded?
faqs.a: Live online, twice a week, with every session recorded so you can revisit it. Doubt threads under this course page stay open throughout, and your trainer replies within 48 hours.

courses.name: AI & Prompt Engineering for Professionals
courses.seoTitle: AI & Prompt Engineering Course — Fees, Syllabus & Career Outcomes
courses.metaDescription: Practical AI course for working professionals: prompt engineering, retrieval-augmented generation, AI automation and building assistants. 8 weeks live online. See fees, syllabus and outcomes.
courses.tagline: Stop watching AI demos. Build the automations your workplace will pay for.
courses.intro: Most AI courses stop at clever prompts. This one goes further: you will connect an AI model to real documents, wire it into a workflow, measure whether the output is actually correct, and hand the result to someone who is not technical. That gap — between a demo and something a business can rely on — is where the money is.

paths.job: AI Associate, Automation Analyst, AI-enabled Marketing or Ops roles
paths.freelance: Building AI assistants and document workflows for agencies and SMEs
paths.business: Selling AI automation retainers to local businesses

modules.title: How language models actually work
modules.detail: Tokens, context windows, temperature and hallucination — enough mental model to debug bad output instead of guessing.

modules.title: Prompt engineering that survives production
modules.detail: Structured prompts, few-shot examples, output formats, and why a prompt that works once may fail on the hundredth run.

modules.title: Working with your own documents (RAG)
modules.detail: Chunking, embeddings and vector search — build an assistant that answers only from your company's PDFs and policies.

modules.title: Automating real workflows
modules.detail: Connect AI to spreadsheets, email and forms using no-code tools, then graduate to simple API scripts.

modules.title: Evaluating AI output
modules.detail: Build a test set, score responses, and prove to a client that your system is right often enough to trust.

modules.title: Cost, privacy and safe deployment
modules.detail: Token economics, what you must never send to a public model, and how to talk to a client about data handling.

modules.title: Packaging and pricing AI work
modules.detail: Scoping an automation project, writing the proposal, and setting a retainer that reflects saved hours.

modules.title: Capstone: ship a working AI assistant
modules.detail: Deliver an end-to-end assistant for a real use case, with documentation and an evaluation report.

outcomes: Build a document-grounded AI assistant from scratch
Automate a repetitive business workflow end to end
Measure and defend the accuracy of an AI system
Scope and price an AI automation project for a client
Publish a working AI project to your Skill Passport

faqs.q: Do I need to know coding to join this AI course?
faqs.a: No. The first half is entirely no-code and works through visual automation tools. Light Python appears in the second half, and we teach it from zero — you will be reading and editing scripts, not writing them from a blank file.

faqs.q: What are the AI and prompt engineering course fees?
faqs.a: ₹14,500 for the full 8-week programme, including live sessions, recordings and API credits for your capstone project. EMI options are available.

faqs.q: Is this course useful if I am not from an IT background?
faqs.a: Very. Marketers, HR professionals, teachers and operations staff often get the fastest return, because they already know which repetitive task is worth automating. Around half of each cohort comes from non-IT roles.

faqs.q: Which AI models will I learn to work with?
faqs.a: The course is deliberately model-agnostic. You will work hands-on with current commercial models through their APIs and learn the patterns that transfer when models change — which they do, frequently.

faqs.q: Can I really earn freelance income from this?
faqs.a: Small businesses are actively paying for AI automation but struggle to find people who can scope it properly. The final module is dedicated to packaging, pricing and pitching, and your capstone doubles as your first portfolio piece.

courses.name: IT Infrastructure & Networking
courses.seoTitle: IT Infrastructure & Networking Course — Fees, Syllabus & Placement
courses.metaDescription: Hands-on IT infrastructure and networking course covering servers, routing, switching, Active Directory, virtualisation and IT support. 10 weeks with placement support. See fees and syllabus.
courses.tagline: The layer everything else runs on — and a reliable entry door into IT.
courses.earning: ₹3–6 LPA as an IT Support / Infra Engineer
courses.intro: Every company that owns a laptop needs someone who understands infrastructure. This course builds that foundation properly — networking, servers, identity and virtualisation — and it remains one of the most dependable ways into an IT career without a computer-science degree.

paths.job: IT Support Engineer, Network Administrator, Infrastructure Associate
paths.freelance: Network setup and IT audits for clinics, schools and small offices
paths.business: Annual maintenance contracts for local businesses

modules.title: How networks actually move data
modules.detail: The OSI model made practical: IP addressing, subnetting, DNS and DHCP, with packet captures you can read.

modules.title: Routing and switching
modules.detail: VLANs, static and dynamic routing, and building a small multi-site network in a simulator.

modules.title: Server administration
modules.detail: Windows Server and Linux side by side — users, permissions, file shares, scheduled jobs and patching.

modules.title: Active Directory & identity
modules.detail: Domains, group policy and single sign-on — the backbone of nearly every corporate IT estate.

modules.title: Virtualisation
modules.detail: Hypervisors, virtual machines, snapshots and resource planning using VMware and Hyper-V.

modules.title: Backup, recovery & business continuity
modules.detail: Backup strategies, RTO and RPO, and actually restoring from a backup under time pressure.

modules.title: Security hardening & monitoring
modules.detail: Firewalls, VPNs, endpoint protection and reading logs to spot a problem before users report it.

modules.title: Capstone: design a small-office IT estate
modules.detail: Deliver a full network diagram, server plan, backup policy and cost sheet for a 40-person company.

outcomes: Subnet a network correctly without a calculator
Build and manage a Windows domain with group policy
Design a backup and recovery plan you have personally tested
Diagnose connectivity faults methodically instead of by trial and error
Present a complete small-office infrastructure design

faqs.q: Is this course enough to get an IT support job?
faqs.a: It covers what entry-level IT support and infrastructure roles test for: networking fundamentals, Windows and Linux administration, Active Directory and troubleshooting method. Combined with the capstone and mock interviews, learners typically target IT Support Engineer or Network Administrator roles.

faqs.q: What are the IT infrastructure course fees?
faqs.a: ₹16,000 for 10 weeks, including live sessions, recorded lectures and remote lab access for the full duration of the course plus 30 days afterwards.

faqs.q: Does this prepare me for CCNA?
faqs.a: The routing, switching and networking modules cover a substantial part of the CCNA foundation. It is not a CCNA exam-cram course — the goal is working competence — but learners who go on to CCNA find the groundwork already done.

faqs.q: Do I need my own hardware or lab equipment?
faqs.a: No. All practical work is done in simulators and remote labs that we provide. A laptop with 8 GB of RAM and a stable internet connection is sufficient.

faqs.q: How is this different from the cloud computing course?
faqs.a: This course covers the traditional infrastructure most companies still run, and it is the better starting point if you are completely new to IT. Many learners take this first and follow it with the cloud course.

courses.name: Presales & Solution Consulting
courses.seoTitle: Presales & Solution Consulting Course — Fees, Syllabus & Career Path
courses.metaDescription: Presales training for IT professionals: discovery calls, solution design, RFP and proposal writing, demos, and pricing. 6 weeks live online. See fees, syllabus and salary outcomes.
courses.tagline: The highest-paying pivot for technical people who can also talk to customers.
courses.earning: ₹8–20 LPA as a Presales / Solution Consultant
courses.intro: Presales sits between engineering and sales, and it is chronically short of good people. If you understand technology but are tired of being invisible to the business, this is the most direct route to a senior, well-paid, client-facing role — and almost nobody in India teaches it formally.

paths.job: Presales Consultant, Solution Architect, Technical Account Manager
paths.freelance: Bid and RFP support for IT services firms on a per-proposal basis
paths.business: Independent solution consulting for SaaS vendors entering new markets

modules.title: What presales really is

modules.title: Discovery that uncovers the real problem
modules.detail: Question frameworks, stakeholder mapping, and hearing the unstated constraint behind a customer's stated requirement.

modules.title: Solution design & architecture storytelling
modules.detail: Turning requirements into an architecture the customer's own team can defend internally after you leave the room.

modules.title: The demo that closes

modules.title: RFPs, RFIs and proposal writing
modules.detail: Reading an RFP for hidden disqualifiers, writing compliant responses, and building a reusable answer library.

modules.title: Pricing, effort estimation & commercials

modules.title: Capstone: run a full deal cycle
modules.detail: Take a live scenario from discovery through solution, demo, proposal and pricing — assessed by a working presales leader.

outcomes: Run a structured discovery call that surfaces the real requirement
Design and present a solution architecture to a mixed audience
Write a compliant, persuasive RFP response
Estimate effort and defend a price under pressure
Deliver a recorded demo good enough to use as a portfolio piece

faqs.q: Who should take a presales course?
faqs.a: Developers, testers, support engineers and infrastructure staff who enjoy explaining technology to customers, plus sales professionals who want to become technically credible. Some exposure to IT products or services is assumed.

faqs.q: What are the presales course fees?
faqs.a: ₹21,000 for 6 weeks. It is our highest-priced course because every cohort is capped at 15 learners so that each person gets individually reviewed demo and proposal practice.

faqs.q: What salary can a presales consultant expect in India?
faqs.a: Entry into presales from a technical role commonly lands in the ₹8–12 LPA band, with experienced solution consultants and architects well above that. The role also carries incentive components tied to deal closure.

faqs.q: Is presales a sales job with a target?
faqs.a: Presales supports the sales team technically and usually carries a shared or team target rather than an individual quota. You are measured on solution quality, demo effectiveness and win rate, not on cold calling.

faqs.q: Will I get to practise demos with real feedback?
faqs.a: Yes — that is the core of the course. You deliver multiple recorded demos and receive line-by-line feedback from a practising presales leader, which most people have never had in their career.

courses.intro: Digital marketing is the single most reliable skill on this platform for reaching all three earning paths — a job, freelance clients, or promoting your own business. This course is built around one rule: you never learn a channel without running something live in it.

paths.freelance: Monthly retainers managing ads and SEO for small businesses
paths.business: Marketing your own venture without hiring an agency

modules.detail: Audience, offer and message — why most campaigns fail before a single rupee is spent on ads.

modules.title: Search engine optimisation

Run profitable Google and Meta campaigns end to end
Build a GA4 dashboard that reports on business outcomes
Produce a client-ready monthly marketing report
Land your first freelance retainer with a live case study

faqs.q: What are the digital marketing course fees at Jobjila?
faqs.a: ₹15,500 for the 10-week programme. This includes live sessions, recordings, tool access during the course, and a small managed ad budget for your live capstone campaign so you are not spending your own money to learn.

faqs.q: Can I get a job after a digital marketing course?
faqs.a: Yes, this is one of the most active hiring categories for entry-level roles. What separates candidates who get hired is a portfolio of real campaigns with real numbers — which is exactly what the capstone produces.

faqs.q: Is digital marketing good for freelancing?
faqs.a: It is arguably the best freelance skill on this platform, because small businesses need it continuously and pay monthly retainers rather than one-off fees. Many learners start with one local client while still employed.

faqs.q: Do I need a marketing degree or background?
faqs.a: No. The course starts from fundamentals. Curiosity about why people buy things matters far more than any prior qualification.

faqs.q: Will I get certified in Google Ads?
faqs.a: We prepare you for the free Google Ads and GA4 certifications and run practice sessions, but those certificates are issued by Google directly. Your Jobjila Skill Passport separately records your verified campaign results, which employers find more convincing.

courses.name: Website Design & Development

paths.job: Web Designer, Front-end Developer, WordPress Developer
paths.freelance: Website projects for local businesses, typically ₹15k–₹60k each
paths.business: Running a small web studio with recurring maintenance income

modules.title: Responsive & mobile-first build
modules.detail: Building for a ₹8,000 Android phone on a patchy connection, because that is what most Indian visitors are using.

modules.title: WordPress & no-code delivery
modules.detail: Themes, page builders and plugins — how to deliver a client site in days instead of weeks when the budget is small.

modules.title: Performance, accessibility & on-page SEO
modules.detail: Image optimisation, Core Web Vitals, alt text, heading structure and meta tags that help the site get found.

modules.title: Domains, hosting & handover

modules.title: Capstone: a complete client website

outcomes: Design a professional multi-page site in Figma
Build a fast, responsive site in clean HTML and CSS
Deliver a WordPress site a non-technical client can update
Score well on Core Web Vitals and on-page SEO
Quote, invoice and hand over a project like a professional

faqs.q: What are the website designing course fees?
faqs.a: ₹12,500 for 8 weeks, including live sessions, recordings, Figma practice files and hosting for your capstone project for the first year.

faqs.q: Do I need to know programming before joining?
faqs.a: No. This course assumes no prior coding at all. HTML and CSS are taught from the very first tag, and the no-code track means you can deliver paid client work even before you feel fluent in code.

faqs.q: Will I learn JavaScript in this course?
faqs.a: Only lightly — enough for interactive menus, sliders and form validation. The focus here is design and delivery. Learners who want to go deeper into JavaScript usually follow this with a front-end development track.

faqs.q: How soon can I take on freelance website projects?
faqs.a: The no-code and WordPress modules land in week five, and many learners take their first small paid project around then. Your capstone site doubles as the portfolio piece you show prospective clients.

faqs.q: Is WordPress still worth learning?
faqs.a: For the Indian small-business market, yes — it remains the fastest way to deliver a maintainable site at a price a local client will actually pay. We teach hand-coded and WordPress delivery together so you can choose per project.

courses.intro: Most people who fail at freelancing are not bad at their craft — they are bad at finding clients, quoting confidently and getting paid. This short, intense bootcamp fixes exactly that, and it pairs with any technical or creative course on this platform.

paths.job: Stronger negotiation and client skills in any role
paths.freelance: A working client pipeline and your first paid project
paths.business: The foundation for turning solo work into a small agency

Run outreach that produces genuine client conversations
Quote a project confidently and defend the number
Send a proposal and contract that protect your scope and payment
Have a tracked pipeline instead of hoping for referrals

faqs.q: Do I need a skill already to join the freelancing bootcamp?
faqs.a: Yes — this course teaches the business of freelancing, not a delivery skill. It works best taken alongside or straight after a skill course such as digital marketing, web design or AI automation.

faqs.q: What are the freelancing bootcamp fees?
faqs.a: ₹6,500 for 4 weeks. It is intentionally our most affordable course because it multiplies the value of every other course on the platform.

faqs.q: Will Jobjila give me clients directly?
faqs.a: Graduates with a verified Skill Passport are eligible to be matched with projects posted by clients on the platform. That is a genuine channel, but the bootcamp deliberately teaches you to build your own pipeline so you are never dependent on one source.

faqs.q: Can I freelance while working a full-time job?
faqs.a: Most learners in this bootcamp do exactly that. The workload is designed around evenings and weekends. Do check your employment contract for any moonlighting clause before you take paid work.

faqs.q: How much can a beginner freelancer realistically earn?
faqs.a: Early projects in the Indian market commonly range from ₹5,000 to ₹25,000 depending on the skill. What changes the picture is retainers — one ₹20,000 monthly retainer is worth more than chasing five one-off jobs.

courses.intro: You do not need Python to start a career in data. Most analyst work in Indian companies still happens in Excel, SQL and Power BI — and being genuinely good at those three, plus being able to explain what the numbers mean, is a complete and hireable skill set.

faqs.q: Do I need Python for a data analyst job?
faqs.a: Not for most entry-level analyst roles in India, which run on Excel, SQL and a BI tool. Python becomes valuable later, particularly if you move towards data science — but it is not the barrier people assume it is.

faqs.q: What are the data analytics course fees?
faqs.a: ₹13,500 for 8 weeks, including live sessions, recordings and all practice datasets. Power BI Desktop itself is free.

faqs.q: Is this course suitable for a non-IT background?
faqs.a: Yes, and commerce, finance and operations backgrounds often do particularly well because they already understand the business context behind the numbers.

faqs.q: What kind of job can I get after this course?
faqs.a: The common entry titles are Data Analyst, MIS Executive and Business Analyst. Reporting-heavy roles in finance, operations and marketing also hire directly from this skill set.

faqs.q: Will I work with real datasets?
faqs.a: Yes. Every module uses realistic, deliberately messy datasets rather than pre-cleaned textbook files, because cleaning is most of the actual job.
